title: Worker Reporting
description: Defines the structure for worker progress, blocker, and status reports. Every report MUST be native-generated (not a human-authored summary).

reportId.description: Globally unique report identifier. Format: report-{agentId}-{sequenceNumber}.

capsuleId.description: The capsule this report is filed under.

reportType.description: PROGRESS = periodic update, BLOCKER = issue requiring resolution, STATUS = completion declaration.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

detail.description: Free-text description of the report content. Must be substantive, not a placeholder.

completionPercent.description: Integer 0-100 representing estimated completion percentage of the agent's assigned work.

filesCreated.description: List of files created since last report. Every entry MUST include SHA256.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the created file.

sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the file contents.

blockersDetected.description: Active blockers the agent has identified. Empty array means no blockers.

severity.description: Blocker severity. P0 = blocks all progress, P1 = degrades quality, P2 = minor.

targetGate.description: The gate or milestone this blocker targets.

nextExpectedMilestone.description: The next milestone the agent expects to reach. Must be concrete and verifiable.

nativeGenerated.description: MUST be true. Indicates this report was generated by the agent system itself, not authored by a human.
